title: apoc deployment failing: disk space on remote host
description: nixos-rebuild switch for apoc failed during remote build. Two derivations failed with 'builder failed with exit code 1' and note 'build failure may have been caused by lack of free disk space': /nix/store/gyia21ljgz2yf770ar42r41gnnifnnh4-NetworkManager.conf.drv and /nix/store/2xxm6zs7d134l5qhjldqyc8zn3bsqn2n-xkb-validated.drv. Investigate disk usage on apoc, clean up if needed, and retry deploy.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Confirm root cause (disk space vs build bug); 2. Free space or fix build environment on apoc; 3. Successful nixos-rebuild switch for apoc
close_reason: Freed 17.1 GiB with nix-collect-garbage -d on apoc; subsequent just nixos-switch apoc succeeded.

title: ghostty opens in background from KDE launcher icon
description: ghostty launches but does not come to foreground / get focus when opened from the KDE application menu icon. Likely ghostty's single-instance behavior or GTK focus issue under KDE. Investigate and fix via ghostty config or wrapper/desktop entry.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Identify root cause (single-instance vs focus/raise); 2. Apply fix (config or wrapper); 3. Verify ghostty opens in foreground from icon after deploy
close_reason: Added ~/.config/ghostty/config for fs@apoc with gtk-single-instance=false to prevent ghostty from opening behind existing windows when launched from KDE icon. nix flake check --no-build passed.

title: ghostty fails on apoc VM due to OpenGL 4.3 requirement
description: ghostty was added to apoc desktop packages but fails to launch on the Parallels VM. Error: 'OpenGL version is too old. Ghostty requires OpenGL 4.3'. The VM reports OpenGL 4.0. Need to decide: remove ghostty from apoc, keep it for future hardware migration, or configure software rendering if supported.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Confirm root cause (VM GPU lacks OpenGL 4.3); 2. Decide resolution (remove/keep/workaround); 3. Apply chosen fix and verify
close_reason: Removed ghostty from hosts/modules/packages/linux/desktop.nix because Parallels VM only exposes OpenGL 4.0 and ghostty requires 4.3. Recommended konsole (already installed via KDE) as the native alternative. nix flake check --no-build passed.

title: Investigate apoc prl-tools build ENOSPC
description: nixos switch for apoc fails while building prl-tools because the remote builder reports No space left on device. Determine whether this is an operational cleanup issue or a config fix.
close_reason: Remote apoc root filesystem was full; sudo nix-collect-garbage --delete-older-than 7d freed 15.3 GiB, then just nixos-switch apoc completed successfully.

title: Remove Orca from neo nix config
description: Orca is managed outside Nix, so remove its cask and Dock pin from the neo configuration.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Remove stablyai/orca/orca cask and tap; 2. Remove /Applications/Orca.app from dock; 3. nix flake check --no-build passes; 4. just darwin-switch neo succeeds.
close_reason: Removed stablyai/orca tap, orca cask, and /Applications/Orca.app from neo dock. just darwin-switch neo succeeded.

title: Pin Orca and Wispr Flow to neo dock
description: Install the Stably AI Orca app and add both Orca and Wispr Flow to neo's Dock persistent apps.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Orca cask installed via stablyai/orca tap; 2. /Applications/Orca.app and /Applications/Wispr Flow.app added to dock persistent-apps; 3. nix flake check --no-build passes; 4. just darwin-switch neo succeeds.
notes: Config validated (nix flake check --no-build passes). Deploy blocked: sudo password required in non-interactive session, and GitHub API rate limit exceeded for nix-darwin/nix-darwin. Run just darwin-switch neo locally to apply.
close_reason: Deployed successfully after removing stale /opt/homebrew/bin/obsidian symlink. Orca and Wispr Flow are installed and pinned to the Dock.

title: Fix Homebrew cask pycharm error on neo
description: nix-darwin Homebrew bundle fails because the pinned Homebrew version does not understand the cask command_wrapper DSL used by the current pycharm cask. Update nix-homebrew so brew can parse current casks.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Update nix-homebrew input; 2. nix flake check --no-build passes; 3. just darwin-switch neo succeeds.
close_reason: Overrode nix-homebrew's brew-src input to Homebrew 6.0.13, which includes the cask command_wrapper DSL. just darwin-switch neo now succeeds.

title: Install Wispr Flow on neo
description: Add the Wispr Flow voice dictation app to the neo macOS host via Homebrew cask.
acceptance_criteria: 1. wispr-flow cask added to neo's homebrew config; 2. nix flake check --no-build passes; 3. deploy succeeds or is ready to deploy.
close_reason: Added wispr-flow cask to hosts/modules/packages/darwin/homebrew.nix; nix flake check --no-build passed and just darwin-switch neo installed it.

title: Auto-stage flake files before deploy
description: Make build/switch recipes stage nix files, lockfile, and referenced assets before nix evaluates the flake, so new/untracked files are included in remote deploys.
acceptance_criteria: 1. _stage-flake recipe exists and stages relevant files; 2. All deploy one-shot recipes call it; 3. just --dump succeeds; 4. nix flake check --no-build passes.
close_reason: Added _stage-flake recipe and called it from all deploy one-shot recipes; just --dump and nix flake check --no-build pass.

title: Set apoc wallpaper and lockscreen via Nix
description: Declaratively configure the Plasma desktop wallpaper and session lockscreen for the apoc NixOS host using the existing files/wallpapers/wallpaper.jpg asset.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Lockscreen background is set via kscreenlockerrc; 2. Desktop wallpaper is applied on Plasma login and during home-manager switch when a session exists; 3. nix flake check --no-build passes.
close_reason: Added home/modules/plasma.nix with kscreenlockerrc and autostart wallpaper for fs@apoc; nix flake check --no-build passed.

title: Re-add ghostty to apoc with software rendering wrapper
description: Assessment: the shared advice is correct — Mesa's LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 forces llvmpipe software rendering, which advertises OpenGL 4.5 and should satisfy ghostty's OpenGL 4.3 requirement inside the Parallels VM. Implement ghostty on apoc via a wrapper that sets this env var so it launches cleanly from app drawer and shell.
acceptance_criteria: 1. ghostty re-added to apoc in a way that avoids OpenGL 4.0 limitation; 2. nix flake check --no-build passes; 3. ghostty launches without OpenGL errors in VM
close_reason: Re-added ghostty to apoc desktop packages via symlinkJoin wrapper that sets LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1, forcing Mesa software rendering (OpenGL 4.5 via llvmpipe) to bypass Parallels VM's OpenGL 4.0 limit. nix flake check --no-build passed; wrapped ghostty confirmed in apoc system packages.

title: Enable OpenGL 4.3+ in Proxmox VM for ghostty
description: ghostty requires OpenGL 4.3 but apoc Proxmox VM currently reports OpenGL 4.0, causing ghostty to fail. Need to investigate Proxmox VM display/GPU options to provide OpenGL 4.3 support: options include GPU PCI passthrough, VirGL if host GPU supports it, or alternative display configurations. This is Proxmox/VM-level config, not NixOS config.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Identify current virtual GPU/driver in use on apoc; 2. Evaluate Proxmox options for OpenGL 4.3 (passthrough, VirGL, etc.); 3. Implement chosen solution; 4. Verify ghostty launches successfully

title: Add automatic nix store garbage collection for linux hosts
description: Configure automatic periodic nix store garbage collection on all linux hosts (shared config) to prevent disk space issues like the recent apoc deployment failure. Use nix.gc.automatic with a sensible interval and retention.
acceptance_criteria: 1. nix.gc.automatic enabled for all linux hosts; 2. Retention policy set (e.g. delete older than 30d); 3. Interval configured (e.g. weekly); 4. nix flake check --no-build passes
close_reason: Added nix.gc.automatic weekly cleanup with 30d retention to hosts/modules/packages/linux/common.nix, shared by desktop.nix and server.nix. nix flake check --no-build passed; gc config confirmed in apoc evaluation.

title: Add ghosty terminal to apoc desktop packages
description: Add the ghosty terminal emulator to the apoc (linux desktop) system packages.
acceptance_criteria: 1. ghosty is installed in apoc's desktop package module; 2. nix flake check --no-build passes; 3. ghosty appears in apoc system packages evaluation
close_reason: Added ghostty to hosts/modules/packages/linux/desktop.nix. nix flake check --no-build passed; ghostty appears in apoc system packages evaluation.

title: Review Nix host configuration structure
description: Review current darwin/linux configuration split. linux desktop system 'apoc' needs vlc. Future linux servers won't need desktop packages like vlc, so prepare a separate server-oriented structure (folder with .gitkeep only).
acceptance_criteria: 1. Darwin/linux config structure reviewed and documented; 2. vlc added to apoc (linux desktop) configuration; 3. linux-server folder created with .gitkeep
notes: Currently two configs: one for darwin, one for linux. linux system 'apoc' is a desktop. Create folder for future linux servers with only .gitkeep.
close_reason: Split linux package modules into desktop/server, moved vlc to desktop.nix, fixed broken system.nix imports, added hosts/linux-server/.gitkeep placeholder. nix flake check --no-build passed.

title: Add StablyAI Orca cask to macOS stack
description: Add stablyai/orca tap and orca cask to hosts/modules/packages/darwin/homebrew.nix for local AI agent.
